Tess (docs): Quick heads-up: I'm opening a model card PR to clarify embedding shard behavior for Lyra-embed-1. Want a tiny migration snippet (old param embed_shard_key -> new embed_shard_index), a note on deterministic mapping, and a short bench sentence for recommended shard_count. Need owners.

Hugo (eng-ml): SGTM. Recommendation: default shard_count=1 for small deployments, shard_count=4 for production 1536-dim vectors on 16GB GPUs. Include a sentence about increased cold-starts when shard_count > 8.

Nadia (sdk): I can draft JS + curl snippets. Do we want to show both mapping and a quick hash example (to map keys -> index)?

Tess (docs): Yes please. Keep snippets minimal: 1) how to set embed_shard_index in request, 2) simple mapping example like `index = murmur3(id) % shard_count`. Also add a compatibility note for SDKs <2.4.0.

Olivia (bench): Numbers: shard_count=1 p50 48ms; shard_count=4 p50 30ms p95 125ms under 32qps; shard_count=8 p50 28ms but p99 climbs due to cross-shard aggregation. I'll attach CSV to the PR.

Nadia (sdk): Draft JS snippet:
```js
// request a specific shard index
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'lyra-embed-1',
  input: ['doc 1','doc 2'],
  embed_shard_index: 0,
  shard_count: 4
});
console.log(resp.data);
```

Nadia (sdk): Curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"lyra-embed-1","input":["a","b"],"embed_shard_index":0,"shard_count":4}'
```

Nadia (sdk): Minimal mapping example (pseudo): 
```
# Python example mapping id -> shard index
import mmh3
def shard_index(id, shard_count):
    return mmh3.hash(id) % shard_count
```

Tess (docs): Great. Add a migration note: "If you previously used embed_shard_key, map your stable keys to integers prior to migration; keys will be ignored after the deprecation date." Also include troubleshooting: 400 if embed_shard_index >= shard_count.

Hugo (eng-ml): Add a technical callout: use deterministic hashing (murmur3 or farmhash) so routing is stable across clients. Mention that differing hash implementations will cause routing skew.

Olivia (bench): Also include cost tradeoff line: more shards -> more parallelism but higher GPU-hours and possible cross-shard aggregation overhead. Link to bench CSV in PR.

legal-bot: Reminder: examples must avoid PII. Use hashed IDs or synthetic examples in docs.

Tess (docs): Will include legal blurb and placeholder values. I'll open PR with: migration checklist, JS/python/curl snippets, shard mapping example, bench blurb+CSV link, compatibility note for older SDKs, and troubleshooting bullets. Assigning reviewers @Hugo and @Nadia. ETA: EOD today.

Nadia (sdk): Quick follow-up: SDKs <2.4.0 don't accept embed_shard_index param; recommend upgrade or use raw HTTP. I'll add that to the PR description.

Hugo (eng-ml): Quick wording suggestion for card: "Recommended: shard_count=4 for standard throughput/latency tradeoffs. Test with your corpus; we expose shard health in Console."

Tess (docs): Perfect, adding that line. Will ping when preview is ready. Thanks all :rocket:
